data.observation: A controlled editor-mode map was created, Reactor Explosions was visibly enabled, and Steam Generators plus an adjacent Item Source were placed. The Item Source was not configured to Blast Compound and no payload transport, explosion, retrieval, or redeployment was completed before the investigation time limit.

data.summary: No 0-HP generator ghost state was observed. I created a controlled editor-mode map, explicitly enabled Reactor Explosions, and placed Steam Generators with an adjacent Item Source, but the required Blast Compound configuration and the payload-conveyor explosion/retrieval/redeployment sequence were not completed before the tool-time limit.
